archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) for tactile feel
rationale: For a 'smart human consultant' AI whiteboard, the interface must feel authoritative and clean (Swiss), while the canvas itself must feel tactile, organic, and approachable (Earthy/Hand-drawn). We use a premium Light Theme to replicate high-quality paper/whiteboards, avoiding clinical grays or childish primary colors.

background.description: Soft off-white for the main canvas, reducing eye strain compared to pure white.

rules: Use Caveat ONLY for AI-generated whiteboard drawings and annotations.
Use Outfit for all UI panel headings and Manrope for UI text/transcripts.

media_and_icons.icon_instructions: Use 'Duotone' weight for major sidebar actions. Use 'Regular' weight for dense controls. Execute `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.

image_urls.description: Fallback texture if CSS pattern is not desired. Use CSS radial-gradient grid as primary preference.

technical_instructions.file_extension: Use .js and .jsx for all React components. Do NOT use .tsx or .ts files.
technical_instructions.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, canvas nodes, and conversational panels MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="toggle-voice-btn"`).
technical_instructions.shadcn_customization: Heavily customize Shadcn components. Remove the default standard border radius. Use full rounded pills (`rounded-full`) for standard buttons and large rounded corners (`rounded-2xl`) for panels.
technical_instructions.whiteboard_implementation: Use inline SVGs driven by React state or framer-motion for drawing strokes. Do not attempt to use HTML <canvas> unless strictly necessary for performance, as SVG paths are easier to animate with 'pathLength'.
